basic_details.scholarship_name: Erasmus Mundus Master in Green, Networked and Inspiring AI (GENIAL)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Université de Lorraine (France - Coordinator), KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Sweden), University of Naples Federico II (Italy), and Lappeenranta-Lahti University of Technology LUT (Finland)
degree_levels: Master of Science (MSc - Multiple Master's Degrees)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Green and Networked Sustainable AI: Low-Power AI Hardware, Energy-Efficient Machine Learning, Edge AI and Green 6G Networks, Sustainable Computing Architectures, and Ethical AI Systems.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~20 to 25 fully funded Erasmus Mundus scholarship grants awarded globally per annual cohort
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition (Partner Country category); Pakistani AI, software, and electronic engineers secure ~2 to 4 full scholarships annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years (full standard duration of 120 ECTS Joint Master's program across minimum 2-3 European partner institutions)
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: €1,400 / month tax-free living allowance for full 24 months (€33,600 total)

nationality_requirements: Open to applicants worldwide (Partner Country category for Pakistan)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age limit; evaluated on academic excellence, technical competencies, and motivation.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor of Science / Engineering in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or Telecommunications (16 years education, 180-240 ECTS equivalent) with minimum CGPA 3.40 / 4.00 (or 78%+ aggregate) from an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: First-class honors or top 10% class percentile equivalent.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate foundation in programming (Python, C/C++), machine learning, digital signal processing or electronics, linear algebra, calculus, and probability.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally provided degree certificate is awarded prior to program commencement in September.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Experience in embedded AI, tinyML, renewable energy systems, or green computing strengthens candidacy.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 overall (minimum 6.0 in each sub-score) or TOEFL iBT minimum 90 (minimum 20 in each sub-score). Standardized test is mandatory under Erasmus Mundus consortium rules.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and examinations across all partner universities are 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates apply through the centralized GENIAL online portal hosted by Université de Lorraine.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicants who have previously received an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree (EMJMD) scholarship are not eligible for a second one.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full participation and tuition fee waiver (€9,000 / year for Partner Country students) covering all consortia universities, laboratory fees, and library charges.

admission_application_fee.details: Online application via the official GENIAL consortium portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Consortium universities assist with reserved student housing in Nancy, Stockholm, Naples, and Lappeenranta; rent is paid from the generous monthly living stipend.
accommodation.amount: Covered via monthly stipend (€350 - €650 / month rent)

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living allowance of €1,400 per month disbursed for the full 24 months of the programme (€33,600 total; ~PKR 420,000 / month; ~PKR 10,080,000 total).

airfare.details: Consortium travel and installation grant embedded into the Erasmus+ scholarship allocation, covering international flights between Pakistan and European study tracks.

visa_fee.details: Schengen study visa and national residence permit fees across France, Sweden, Italy, and Finland are covered from the scholarship installation allocation.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive worldwide private health, accident, and repatriation insurance policy (Marsh or Dr. Walter) compliant with EACEA standards provided 100% free.

food_allowance.details: Covered through the monthly living stipend of €1,400.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to specialized AI hardware labs, FPGA boards, edge TPU clusters, and university computing licenses.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Consortium funding available for students presenting their Master's thesis research at major international AI and green computing conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Inter-consortium mobility travel costs between Year 1 and Year 2 institutions (e.g., France to Sweden or Italy) are fully covered.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple premier European institutions (consortium mobility across at least two EU countries is mandatory).
participating_institutions: KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Stockholm, Sweden)
University of Naples Federico II (Naples, Italy)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Consortium features KTH Royal Institute of Technology (top 80 globally in QS World Rankings, #1 in Sweden for engineering) and Université de Lorraine (renowned for INRIA AI research).
available_majors: Green AI Foundations and Energy-Efficient Computing (Semester 1 - Nancy)
Edge AI and Embedded Low-Power Systems (Track at KTH)
Green Wireless Networks and AI-Driven Communications (Track at Naples)
Sustainable Software Engineering and Circular AI Systems (Track at LUT)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree in CS/AI/EE (180-240 ECTS equivalence), minimum CGPA 3.4/4.0, standardized English test (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90), two academic recommendation letters, CV, and motivation essay.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: All applicants enter a centralized global competition; top-ranked scholars receive both program admission and the prestigious Erasmus Mundus scholarship.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Highlight your passion for sustainable AI and energy efficiency—addressing the carbon footprint of massive AI models, TinyML, and edge intelligence—to align with GENIAL's core mission.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: GENIAL Centralized Online Application System (Université de Lorraine)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on the GENIAL application portal, complete the online application form, designate preferred Year 2 specialization mobility tracks, and upload all required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review GENIAL academic prerequisites and ensure valid English test scores (IELTS min 6.5 or TOEFL min 90).
Step 2: Register on the GENIAL online application portal (https://master-genial.eu/apply/).
Step 3: Complete the academic profile, curriculum details, and preferred specialization track selections.
Step 4: Enter contact details for two academic referees who will receive automated links to submit confidential recommendation letters.
Step 5: Upload attested transcripts, Bachelor's degree certificate, detailed CV, motivation letter, and passport copy before the deadline (typically January 31).
Step 6: Consortium Academic Selection Board ranks all global applications and submits scholarship nomination list to EACEA.
Step 7: Shortlisted and selected candidates receive formal scholarship offer letters in late March or early April.
Step 8: Accept scholarship offer, receive official visa support package from Université de Lorraine, and apply for French Long-Stay Student Visa (VLS-TS) at the Embassy of France in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: Single application via the GENIAL portal serves as both program admission and Erasmus Mundus scholarship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via automated institutional links dispatched directly to their official university email addresses.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Structured motivation letter (maximum 2 pages) addressing technical background, motivation for green and sustainable AI, choice of mobility tracks, and career aspirations.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Summary of technical domain of interest and intended thesis research direction in energy-efficient AI or edge systems.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass CV detailing academic qualifications, technical skills, programming languages, and projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Selection is purely dossier-based; online interviews are conducted only in rare borderline instances.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.5 overall, 6.0 sub-scores) or TOEFL iBT (min 90, 20 sub-scores); GRE is recommended but not mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by HEC and MOFA Pakistan; Matric/Inter by IBCC.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for all official documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via the GENIAL central application system.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Bachelor's Degree Certificate and Academic Transcripts
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for 4-year Bachelor's in CS/AI/EE with minimum CGPA 3.40/4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested copies from HEC and MOFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 6.5 overall, 6.0 in each section) or TOEFL iBT (min 90, 20 in each section).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Score report valid at time of application.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential recommendation letters from university professors who taught or supervised previous research.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit from institutional Pakistani university email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Maximum 2-page essay detailing background, technical competencies, and motivation for sustainable AI.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Demonstrate clear knowledge of the GENIAL curriculum and consortium universities.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Europass CV highlighting technical skills, programming proficiencies, and projects.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Include links to GitHub and academic code repositories.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official certificate confirming permanent residence in Pakistan for the last 12 months (e.g. utility bill, domicile, employer/university letter).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Required under Erasmus Mundus 12-month residency rule.

required_documents_checklist.specification: High-resolution color scan of passport bio page valid for at least 3 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.semester_commencement: Early September (commencing at Université de Lorraine, Nancy)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Centralized global application period runs annually from November to late January. Strict cutoff.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Undergraduate GPA and performance in core AI, computing, and mathematics courses)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Final year capstone project, publications, technical code portfolio, and work experience)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry AI, software development, or embedded engineering experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Quality of motivation letter, clarity of sustainable AI vision, and articulation)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Quality and depth of academic appraisals from professors)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Joint Academic Board comprising professors and coordinators from all 4 consortium universities.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two independent academic reviewers score each dossier according to a standardized 100-point rubric, followed by composite consortium ranking.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~20 to 25 Erasmus Mundus full scholarship awards globally
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2.0% to 3.0% among high-caliber computing and electronics applicants
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.60+ / 4.00 or top 5% class rank from premier Pakistani computing universities (FAST-NUCES, NUST, LUMS, GIKI, UET)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with exceptional computing and electronics foundations, strong machine learning practices, published research, or substantial GitHub project portfolios.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani computer science, artificial intelligence, and electronic engineering faculties.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, China, Vietnam, Nigeria, Brazil, Turkey, Colombia, Egypt.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unauthorized agents claiming to sell Erasmus Mundus scholarship spots.
Applications are submitted solely via https://master-genial.eu/.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: GENIAL does NOT charge any application fee. Any request for money is fraudulent.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: The GENIAL Consortium and the European Commission do not work with commercial agents or agencies.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Police character certificate and legal attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 25,000.
Initial pocket money before first stipend transfer in France: ~€400 (~PKR 120,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can stay in one university for the full 2 years. Reality: Erasmus Mundus requires mobility across at least two different European countries during the Master's program.

Myth: The scholarship stipend must be repaid if you don't return to Pakistan. Reality: Erasmus Mundus scholarships carry zero repayment obligations; scholars are free to pursue global careers or PhDs in Europe.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial websites claim GRE is required; GRE is recommended by GENIAL but is NOT strictly mandatory.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance and earn 60 ECTS per year without fail grades across all consortium universities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance and mandatory participation in consortium academic activities and summer workshops.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester credit audit by the Consortium Coordinating Board at Université de Lorraine.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work is legally permitted under national student visa rules in France, Sweden, Italy, and Finland, but discouraged due to intensive curriculum.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Zero return obligation; graduates receive European joint/multiple degrees and are eligible for European post-study work permits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Active participation in Erasmus Mundus Students and Alumni Association (EMA) activities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Stipend discontinued upon unapproved abandonment of studies or expulsion for academic misconduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Mobility tracks are fixed according to selected curriculum specializations approved by the consortium.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Not applicable; curriculum is unified under the Green, Networked and Inspiring AI joint framework.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship is granted for maximum 24 months; thesis completion beyond 24 months must be self-funded.
